scope: Safe, transactional deletion semantics for user persistence records

scenarios_verified.cascade_effects: Removes saved_places record only; canonical catalog place remains untouched
Room SQLite onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE automatically removes all associated saved_trip_stops and trip_progress records; SwiftData @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade) does the same
scenarios_verified.orphan_risk: Zero orphaned stop or progress records

scenarios_verified.mechanism: User deletes the currently active trip via Trips root
scenarios_verified.cascade_effects: Active progress record deleted atomically; active trip card cleanly vanishes from UI

confirmation_gate: UI requires explicit alert confirmation before deleting an itinerary
